sources.basis: Same program/routine label scope and explicit FOR jump/label restrictions; structured target behavior is a documented Pythonic interpretation

contract.transfer: Jump directly to target label, skip preceding statements and enclosing header dispatch; ordinary target continuation and loop back edges follow
contract.using: Target capture scope chain is a prefix of source chain; no new USING entry even for identical storage
contract.scope: Same body only; duplicates, conflicts, missing labels, FOR-body labels/jumps and condition-action transfers reject
contract.execution: Existing dispatcher/budgets, type/effect checks, errors/RETURN/ABORT cleanup and live cooperative pause/resume
contract.reports: Source-ordered control_flow per-body jumps with expanded endpoint locations/block paths and entry kind; existing source_map carries physical include origins

choices: Permit newly entered IF/WHILE/REPEAT/SELECT blocks only
No fabricated initialization or replay of skipped header/selector side effects
Retain USING captures for valid in-scope transfers and ordinary loop restart semantics
boundaries: No new USING capture bypass or FOR-body labels/jumps
No persisted instruction pointers, native addresses/preemption, controller acceptance or strict equivalence
